preconditions.description: The number of strings n must be between 1 and 10000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 10 for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Each string must have a length between 1 and 10.
The number of questions Q must be between 1 and 500000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L <= R <= n for L, R in questions)
preconditions.description: For each question, L and R must be valid indices within the range of the strings.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of strings containing the substring for each question.
